Disposition.description: completed means the requested outcome is supported; abstained means evidence or authority prevents justified completion (including an unavailable required check); failed means an operation failed and the task could not recover. Use exhausted only after a reported budget/deadline limit, cancelled only for a cancellation request, and interrupted only for actual interruption of execution. A missing tool is not budget exhaustion or interruption.

source_refs.description: Exact accessible record or event IDs returned by Rust. An action operation_id is not an event ID; use its returned evidence_ref for provenance.

discovery_corpus.description: Host-registered immutable discovery corpus. A child cannot replace its parent or root grant corpus.

prepared_run.description: Derived by Rust for prepared reuse. Cannot be supplied in a registered grant.

recognition.description: Whether this motif occurs, independently of whether it succeeds. supported means the observed pattern matches the definition; it may have violated obligations. tentative means the evidence is insufficient to establish that match; rejected means the pattern does not fit.

material.description: For registered_tool, the exact registered tool ID only. For instructions, executable agent guidance. Do not put descriptive prose in a registered tool ID.

required_capabilities.description: Exact tool IDs required by this implementation, all present in the host grant tools. Describe state or file assumptions in state_assumptions instead.

evaluation_refs.description: Saved Evaluation record IDs only; leave empty before evaluation. Motif occurrences belong in provenance.source_refs.

function.description: Authored functional category for exact metadata filtering; not a host-verified applicability claim.

expires_ms.description: Optional absolute Unix timestamp in milliseconds, not a duration. Omit for knowledge without a justified expiry. For a temporary condition, calculate a future timestamp from the trusted run started_ms; an elapsed timestamp makes the memory immediately unavailable.

conflicts.description: IDs of saved records that contradict this memory, or [] when none are identified. Describe uncertainty in content or provenance.limitations; do not put explanatory prose in this ID list.

supersedes.description: IDs of saved memories replaced by this one, or [] when none.

model_version.description: The actual model ID from the trusted run configuration, not the evaluator or tool name.

memory_start_refs.description: IDs of saved Memory records used to initialize each evaluation arm. Use [] when no starting memory is requested. Source event IDs belong in provenance.source_refs, not here.

variants.description: Additional experiment arms only. Rust always includes baseline and candidate. Use [] for the ordinary two-arm comparison; do not repeat those arms here. Extra arms consume the host evaluation limit.

memory_namespace.description: Opaque ID for isolated evaluation memory; not a filesystem path.

invocation_run.description: Actual execute-motif run whose pinned implementation and bindings match this transplant. Omit for advisory preparation without execution.

id.description: Omit when creating a record; Rust assigns its ID. Supply an existing record ID only for a permitted update.

evidence_ref.description: Exact host event ID for this settled receipt. Use it in provenance.source_refs or evidence_refs. Absent while an intent is still unsettled.

outcome_basis.description: Evidence supporting the outcome. Absent on legacy receipts; absence never establishes execution or validation.

validations.description: Host-captured checks, including exact tool/policy and input/target versions. Missing on legacy receipts.

restored_validity.description: Declared target validity restored by this finalization. Historical observation; revalidate before later use.

settlement.description: Separate host decision that the executor has stopped. The original outcome remains unknown, and validity is not restored.

discovery_corpus.description: Host-registered immutable discovery corpus. A child cannot replace its parent or root grant corpus.

invocation.description: Host-selected invocation. Experimental authority is accepted only in sandbox mode; agent work tools cannot set it.

id.description: Copy the returned ID verbatim. For a reference {id,version}, pass only id; do not append the separate version.

run_id.description: Optional filter for the run that produced source events. Omit to read every workflow producer within the grant. Do not substitute a grant ID or invent a run ID.

neighbors.description: With explicit event_refs, include one hop of declared parents and children. Other filters still apply; relationships remain source-reported, not proven causal.

query.description: Literal case-insensitive substring of serialized event JSON. This searches events; search.query remains record search.

through_cursor.description: Optional inclusive cursor ceiling for this selection. A caller-selected filter is not proof of online-only visibility.

eligible.description: Filter implementation candidates by granted tool capabilities and effect mode, without requiring admission.

after.description: Opaque cursor from the preceding page. Preserve the query and filters and set offset=0.

branch_id.description: Omit to read the live workspace. Supply the branch receipt output to read that isolated copy.

snapshot_id.description: Optional ID of an earlier retained read. Only that read window is available. Omit for a fresh host read.

required_freshness.description: Defaults to current. Historical evidence may remain usable after revision; neither mode grants access to deleted or unauthorized sources.

memory_namespace.description: Opaque ID for isolated evaluation memory. The host supplies the actual workspace separately; command evaluators run in that working directory.

memory_start.description: Frozen, scope-checked starting memory. The evaluator initializes each new memory_namespace from these records; retained namespaces keep their subsequent learning state.

id.description: Copy the returned ID verbatim. For a reference {id,version}, pass only id; do not append the separate version.

version.description: Copy the returned ID verbatim. For a reference {id,version}, pass only id; do not append the separate version.
